description: This Java class defines a database migration for an Android application, specifically migrating from version 23 to 24. It removes a preference key 'branding_text' from SharedPreferences as part of the migration process.

classes.name: Migration_23_24
classes.description: A Room database migration class that removes a specific shared preference key during migration from version 23 to 24.

methods.name: Migration_23_24
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the migration with source version 23 and target version 24, and stores the application context.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the migration logic, removing the 'branding_text' preference from SharedPreferences.
